title: Known by Name
story:
A little girl visited a library for the first time.

Thousands of books filled the shelves.

She wondered how the librarian could possibly know where every book belonged.

The librarian smiled and said,

"Every book has its own place. None of them are forgotten."

Within moments, she found the exact book the girl was looking for.

The little girl was amazed.

If someone could carefully keep track of thousands of books, how much more does God know each one of His children?

Jesus taught that God knows us completely.

He even knows the number of hairs on our heads.

Nothing about our lives escapes His attention.

When we feel unnoticed or forgotten, we can rest in the assurance that our Heavenly Father knows every detail about us and lovingly watches over us.
life_lesson: God knows every detail of your life. You are never forgotten, overlooked, or insignificant in His eyes.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for knowing me completely.

Thank You that nothing in my life is hidden from You.

Help me to trust Your loving care, even when I feel unnoticed or alone.

Remind me each day that I am precious in Your sight.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Have you ever felt unnoticed or forgotten?

How does knowing that God knows every detail about you bring comfort today?

How can you rest more fully in His loving care?
verse: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
